specs.title: axe scans history, social, settings and local setup families
keyboard board keeps one roving tab stop and Escape clears selection
reduced motion forces low visual tier and keeps the shell usable
screen matrix has no horizontal overflow at supported widths
all public route aliases boot without an app error or horizontal overflow
theme, motion and audio defaults remain deterministic across the release matrix
public shell uses Vietnamese navigation
mobile exposes safe bottom navigation
history keeps filters, canonical detail context and a read-only final thumbnail
game room hides global navigation and renders a 9 by 9 board
result screen stays explicit for GOAL_REACHED
result screen stays explicit for TIMEOUT
result screen stays explicit for SURRENDER
result screen stays explicit for SERVER_INTERRUPTION
result rematch shows a server-authoritative pending state
offline keeps canonical orientation across BLUE and RED turns
AI keeps BLUE orientation while the bot takes its turn
online BLUE viewer stays fixed with self on the near side
online RED viewer stays fixed with self on the near side
spectator always uses canonical BLUE orientation
spectator is read-only and exposes canonical activity feeds
private spectator entry keeps password and error copy in Vietnamese
not found screen provides branded explanation and lobby action
registration keeps recovery acknowledgement gated
profile edit modal persists a combined profile update
friend card keeps secondary actions in an accessible menu
authenticated homepage preserves friends preview and horizontal room scrolling
room browser applies realtime room-list sync without a refresh
privacy presence preference persists across settings reload
Queue cancel waits for server ACK and keeps the closed queue in place
browser Back waits for cancellation and keeps the queue on failed ACK
R10 Bot Online custom room exposes role toggles and gates room creation on preflight
legacy Guest Arena play URL redirects to normal Offline2P
Guest onboarding generates a stable name and persists an edited nickname
two tabs without Web Locks never overlap Guest bootstrap
R7 queue search stage is explicit and calm in the browser
R7 referee Start is role-gated in the waiting room
R7 player view never exposes referee Start
R8 referee can stop with a public reason and sees the authoritative pause overlay
R8 player sees a nondismissible wait state and no referee controls
R8 referee can hold the three-second resume preparation
R8 pause surface remains usable at the mobile viewport
R9 Workbench keeps library, upload and private inspector regions explicit
